info.title: API.SH: Untappd
info.description: The Untappd API from API.SH: public Untappd data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A brewery's beers on Untappd with the brewery page's style filter and sorts. Each beer: `id`, `name`, `url`, `style`, `description`, `abv`, `ibu`, `rating`, `ratings`, `added` (date), `retired`, `label`. Also `styles` (every style the brewery makes, with its id and number of beers). Untappd shows the first 25 beers per style and sort to visitors who are not logged in; use `style_id` and `sort` to reach the rest, or `/untappd/v1/search/beers` with `brewery_id` for the full list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/untappd-brewery-beers

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A brewery's page name (e.g. SierraNevada), its id, or an untappd.com link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: most_popular (default), least_popular, beer_name_asc, beer_name_desc, highest_rated, lowest_rated, highest_abv, lowest_abv, highest_ibu, lowest_ibu, created_at, created_at_desc.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Beers on Untappd (untappd.com) by name, with the search page's sorts and more filters: style, parent style, brewery, ABV range, in production, homebrew, community award, and near a point. Each beer: `id`, `name`, `url`, `style`, `style_id`, `abv`, `ibu`, `rating`, `ratings`, `popularity`, `brewery` (id, name, logo), `label`, `in_production`, `homebrew`, `non_alcoholic`, `vintage`, `community_awards`, `aliases` and `raw`. Also `total`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/untappd-search-beers

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Beer or brewery name, e.g. `pale ale`, `heady topper`.

parameters.name: style_id
parameters.description: Only this style (ids as in `style_id` of results).

parameters.name: in_production
parameters.description: true: only beers still brewed; false: only retired ones.

parameters.name: community_award
parameters.description: true: only beers with a community award.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude: beers from breweries near this point (with `lng`).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Radius around the point in km (1-500, default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Breweries on Untappd by name, with filters for brewery type, out of business, home breweries and a point. Each: `id`, `name`, `url`, `type`, `type_id`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `beers`, `popularity`, `logo`, `out_of_business`, `homebrewery`, `aliases` and `raw`. Also `total`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/untappd-search-breweries

parameters.name: type_id
parameters.description: Brewery type id (1 macro, 2 micro, 3 nano, 4 brew pub, 5 home, 6 bar/restaurant, 13 winery, and the site's others, as in `type_id` of results).

parameters.name: out_of_business
parameters.description: true: only closed breweries; false: only active ones.

parameters.name: homebrewery
parameters.description: true: only home breweries; false: none.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Bars, restaurants, shops and taprooms on Untappd by name, with the search page's sorts and filters for verified venues, closed venues, category and a point. Each: `id`, `name`, `url`, `primary_category`, `categories`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `verified`, `closed`, `popularity`, `popularity_30_days`, `spotlights`, `has_beer`, `has_wine`, `has_food`, `has_spirits`, `icon` and `raw`. Also `total`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/untappd-search-venues

parameters.name: verified
parameters.description: true: only venues that publish their menu on Untappd.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
